effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` WETH to the vault (safeTransferFrom caller -> vault).
The vault mints kmmWETH shares to `receiver`. The count comes from the share price and a deposit fee read from storage, and no minimum is enforced.
The vault keeps a deposit fee (depositFee from storage, up to 35%) out of the WETH. This lowers the shares minted.
The vault delegatecalls the connector, which deposits the WETH into the Morpho MEV Capital vault. This does not touch the signer's funds directly.
The shares are not transferable (transferable_ = false at init), so `receiver` must be the signer unless a SPENDER role applies.
formats.shown: The intent says "Deposit". The fields show the WETH amount, the share ticker kmmWETH and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit intent is a bare "Deposit" with no asset, amount or vault, and there is no interpolated intent
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit format: "intent": "Deposit", no interpolatedIntent. Case 0 screen intent "Deposit". The blind reader was unsure which contract receives the WETH.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Deposit {assets} into Kiln MEV Capital WETH vault for kmmWETH". Change the intent to "Deposit WETH into Kiln vault".

findings.title: deposit does not show the share amount received; the code computes it and enforces no minimum
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `(uint256 _shares, uint256 _depositFeeAmount) = _previewDeposit(assets, _newTotalAssets, totalSupply());`. Case 0 mined: 386000000000001 kmmWETH arrive to the signer, and the screen shows no share amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC-4626 deposit has no minShares parameter.

findings.title: deposit takes a storage deposit fee from the WETH before it mints shares; the screen does not mention it
findings.fix: None. The fee rate is in storage. The share amount is not shown, so no amount on screen is cut.

cases.notes: The WETH out (0.000386000000000001) is shown exactly. The kmmWETH in shows its ticker and the receiver but not the amount (386000000000001). The code enforces no bound on that amount.

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` kmmWETH to `receiver`.
The signer sends WETH to the vault. The amount is computed from the share price plus the deposit fee (previewMint, rounded up), and no maximum is enforced.
The vault keeps a deposit fee (storage rate, up to 35%) inside the WETH it takes.
The vault delegatecalls the connector, which deposits the WETH into the Morpho vault.
formats.shown: The intent says "Mint". The fields show the deposit asset as the WETH ticker, the minted share amount in kmmWETH, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say the signer pays WETH for the shares
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint format: "intent": "Mint". The WETH outflow is shown only as a raw ticker field: "label": "Deposit asset", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker". Vault.sol _deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(IERC20(asset()), caller, address(this), assets);`
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit WETH for vault shares". Add "interpolatedIntent": "Deposit WETH to mint {shares} to {receiver}".

findings.title: mint does not show how much WETH leaves the signer; the amount is computed with no maximum
findings.evidence: Vault.sol mint: `(uint256 _assets, uint256 _depositFeeAmount) = _previewMint(shares, _newTotalAssets, _newTotalSupply);` then `_deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, _assets, shares, _depositFeeAmount);`
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns kmmWETH shares from `owner`. The count comes from the share price (rounded up), and no maximum is enforced.
If the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault withdraws `assets` WETH through the connector and sends the WETH it gets to `receiver`.
The call accrues the reward fee shares to the vault, which dilutes holders slightly.
formats.shown: The intent says "Withdraw". The fields show the exact WETH amount, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw intent is a bare "Withdraw" with no asset, amount or source vault
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}". Change the intent to "Withdraw WETH from Kiln vault".

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares are burned from the owner; no maximum is enforced
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `uint256 _shares = _convertToShares(assets, Math.Rounding.Ceil, _accrueRewardFee(), totalSupply());` then `_burn(owner, shares)` in _withdraw.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC-4626 withdraw has no maxShares parameter.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` kmmWETH from `owner`.
If the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault withdraws WETH through the connector and sends it to `receiver`. The amount is computed from the share price, and no minimum is enforced.
The call accrues the reward fee shares to the vault.
formats.shown: The intent says "Redeem". The fields show the share amount in kmmWETH, the receiver and the owner. Nothing names the WETH received.

findings.title: redeem never names WETH as the asset the receiver gets
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(IERC20(asset()), receiver, IERC20(asset()).balanceOf(address(this)) - _balanceBefore);`. descriptor.json redeem fields: only "Shares to redeem", "To" and "Owner". The mint format, by contrast, has a constant field for underlyingTicker.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}. Add "interpolatedIntent": "Redeem {shares} for WETH to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem intent is a bare "Redeem" with no amount or asset received
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem vault shares for WETH".

findings.title: redeem does not show the WETH amount received; the code computes it and enforces no minimum
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC-4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter.
